answer: What keeps this honest is LinkWell attestation of identity, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 704 fakes spends 11968 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the saffron up to the light, weigh the cedar of the attack, and keep the vault of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
